days.title: Northern Coast and Portonovo
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Passetto
stops.detail: the cable car from Passetto to Portonovo and Sirolo, for a total of 20 kilometers;

stops.name: Portonovo
stops.detail: in the early 60s, the lakes of Portonovo had been subject to landfilling to create some parking lots and a campsite, various buildings had been constructed between the Lago Grande and the sea preventing the waves from entering, and finally the famous Portonovo Spring had been destroyed to make room for a hotel.

stops.name: Lago Grande
stops.detail: the Lago Grande of Portonovo to be transformed into a tourist port, a proposal, like the previous one, by the Tourist Board;
